description: 【名古屋市】内水氾濫ハザードマップ [flood and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 名古屋市. 令和2年度末の各施設の整備状況を勘案して、想定し得る最大規模の降雨により、下水道・中小河川などが氾濫した場合に想定される浸水区域、浸水深をシミュレーションにより算出したものです。. Coverage: 名古屋市. The portal files it under the publisher 名古屋市. Its tags are ハザードマップ, 名古屋市, 防災. It offers 2 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2026-06-01 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
